description: Google Analytics product event catalog (MER-5306). The Elixir and TypeScript emitters validate against this file; docs/features/analytics/ga-event-catalog.md is the human-readable reference. Values must stay low-cardinality and must never identify a person, cohort, attempt or content item.

user_role.description: Coarse role of the signed-in user for the current page, resolved on the server.

values.instructor: Instructor area, or instructor preview of a course section.
values.author: Authoring area, or template preview.
values.admin: System administrator, or the administration area.

page_area.description: Area of Torus the current route belongs to (MER-5292).

values.public: Anything else, such as sign-in pages.

course_id.description: Base project ID of the course design (section base project in delivery, project in authoring). Never a section, cohort or slug.

page_type.description: Kind of lesson page, for page-related events only.

values.other: Any other resource rendered as a page.

entry_point.description: How the user's session reached the course.

values.direct: Independent Torus account, guest or administrator.

activity_type.description: Activity registration slug, such as oli_multiple_choice.

values.hosted: Video file played by the Torus player.

feature_name.description: Feature the user completed a meaningful action with. Adding a value requires a catalog change and review.

dot_opened.description: Learner opens the DOT AI assistant.

dot_question_submitted.description: Learner sends a question to DOT.

outline_opened.description: Learner opens the lesson outline panel.

notes_opened.description: Learner opens the lesson notes panel.

search_used.description: Learner starts searching the course content on the Learn page.

preview_launched.description: Instructor or author starts previewing a course, once per browser-tab session and course.

template_preview_launched.description: Author starts a template preview, once per browser-tab session and template.

author_publish_clicked.description: Author clicks Publish on the Publish page.

file_type.description: Coarse type of a linked file. Never the URL or file name.

feature_area.description: Area of the feature, derived from feature_name by the writer. Emitters never send it.

course_entered.description: First time a user reaches a course delivery or instructor page in a browser-tab session.

page_completed.description: Learner submits (finalizes) a graded page. Practice-page completion is deferred.

attempt_submitted.description: Learner successfully submits an activity attempt, after the API succeeds.

hint_viewed.description: Learner receives a hint. Requests after the last hint do not count.

video_started.description: First play of a video on a page view.

video_completed.description: Video reaches its end, the same trigger as the xAPI video_completed statement.

feature_used.description: User completes a meaningful feature action.

file_link_clicked.description: User clicks a link to an uploaded or linked file in lesson content.
